title: Minimal polynomials, scaled Jordan frames, and Schur-type majorization in hyperbolic systems
summary: Corresponding to a hyperbolic system $(V, p, e)$, where $V$ is a real finite-dimensional vector space and $p$ is a hyperbolic polynomial of degree $n$ in the direction $e$, we consider the eigenvalue map $λ: V \to R^n$ and the hyperbolicity cone $Λ_+$. In such a system, a scaled Jordan frame is defined as a finite set of rank-one elements whose sum lies in the interior of $Λ_+$.
